Business Context.Product Description: SCAILE offers AI-Powered Go-To-Market Machines designed for niche domination. Their service, described as a 'Visibility Engine,' aims to make their clients the primary answer in AI search results, such as Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT. They achieve this by optimizing a company's entity, category, and trust signals for AI comprehension and creating content specifically for AI-driven search.
Business Context.ICP: Ambitious companies seeking to dominate hyper-niche markets.
